notes.title: Welcome to the Tower of Fate ‘SKYVERN’ & Meet Our Publisher
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629806/6edf72b61f603500c2a0fa77ef7185083a6928c4.jpg

Hey Everyone , Glad to Have You All Joining for Great Mission !

We are so thrilled to share the game we’ve been working on for a while. Skyvern is a unique game coming from our long night to gather together and playing many of “World Saving Fantasy” games. In the middle of our struggle and life threatening fight to beat boss (we need to sleep, but we can't if we don't finish it), something suddenly struck us. 

“What if we create a game where players literally only have 1 hour to finish the game and defeat the final boss, and players will get different endings based on how long they take time until the end ?” 

And here we are , proudly announcing Skyvern after some sleepless night (again) brainstorming the idea ! Get ready to enter a blazing action roguelite game, where you only have 1 hour to defeat the final boss and prevent the tower from collapsing to the land.  

Publisher Announcement

We are happy to announce that we teamed up with indie.io to let Skyvern reach even more players. These guys helped lots of indie games to shine so we are lucky to have them on board. 

For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone.

Wishlist & Subscribe
Don’t forget to add Skyvern to your Wishlists , and keep tuned with exciting news from us !
